title: 第二十七章 圣莲归宗，暗流汹涌
content_zh:
天剑宗，后山禁地，无名太上的洞府中。

    林墨将净灵圣莲小心翼翼地交到无名太上手中，看着这位老人苍白的脸色和眉宇间那挥之不去的黑气，心中充满了愧疚和担忧。若非为了救他，无名太上也不会冒险与那神秘势力的首领交手，更不会被“锈”毒侵蚀至此。

    “前辈，都是弟子无能，连累您了。”林墨声音有些哽咽。

    “傻孩子，说什么胡话。”无名太上接过净灵圣莲，感受着其中蕴含的纯净生命力，脸上露出一丝欣慰的笑容，“你能在问道台上，一剑斩杀轩辕破，扬我天剑宗威名，又从陨神渊这等凶险之地，为老夫取回此等圣药，已经是立下了天大的功劳。老夫这点伤，不碍事。”

    他不再多言，将那株净灵圣莲置于掌心，运转玄功。只见圣莲绽放出柔和的白色光芒，化作一道道精纯的生命元气和净化之力，缓缓融入他的体内。他眉宇间那团黑气，以肉眼可见的速度开始消退，苍白的脸色也恢复了一丝红润。

    片刻之后，无名太上睁开双眼，虽然气息依旧有些虚弱，但眼中的神光已经重新变得清澈、深邃。

    “好了，这‘锈’毒，已经被暂时压制住了。”无名太上道，“净灵圣莲不愧是天地奇珍，效果显著。但要彻底根除，恐怕还需要一些其他的机缘和时间。”

    林墨闻言，稍稍松了口气，但心中的石头并未完全放下。他知道，无名太上说得轻松，但那“锈”毒的厉害，他深有体会。连无名太上这等强者都如此棘手，可见其恐怖之处。

    “前辈，陨神渊那边……”林墨想起在陨神渊深处感受到的那股悸动，以及洛璃为了掩护他而独自断后的情景，心中依旧有些不安。

    无名太上的脸色也变得凝重起来：“陨神渊的异动，老夫已经有所感应。那尊陨落神灵的尸骸，恐怕确实出了问题。而且，这与我们之前发现的各地禁地异动，很可能都指向同一个源头——‘锈’的封印，正在加速崩溃。”

    他看向林墨，目光深邃：“孩子，你如今已经融合了《无始剑经》和剑皇传承，铸就了前所未有的‘无始皇道剑胎’，实力大进。但面对‘锈’这等灭世之灾，依旧远远不够。老夫需要你，尽快成长起来。”

    “弟子明白。”林墨郑重点头。
content_en:
Tianjian Sect, the forbidden area in the back mountain, in the cave of the Nameless Supreme Being.

    Lin Mo carefully handed the Pure Spirit Holy Lotus into the hands of Wuming Taishang. Looking at the old man's pale face and the lingering black air between his eyebrows, his heart was filled with guilt and worry. If it weren't for saving him, Wuming Taishang would not have risked fighting with the leader of the mysterious force, nor would he have been corroded by the "rust" poison.

    "Senior, it's all my disciples' incompetence that has caused you trouble." Lin Mo's voice was choked with sobs.

    "Silly boy, what nonsense are you talking about." The Nameless Supreme Being took the Pure Spirit Holy Lotus and felt the pure vitality contained in it, with a smile of relief on his face. "You can kill Xuanyuan Po with one sword on the platform, make our Heavenly Sword Sect famous, and retrieve this holy medicine for me from a dangerous place like the Meteor God Abyss. You have already made a huge contribution to me. My injury is not a problem."

    He said no more, placed the Pure Spirit Holy Lotus in the palm of his hand, and started to use the mysterious power. I saw the Holy Lotus blooming with soft white light, turning into streams of pure life energy and purifying power, slowly integrating into his body. The black air between his brows began to fade away at a speed visible to the naked eye, and his pale face also regained a trace of rosiness.

    After a moment, Wuming Taishang opened his eyes. Although his breath was still a little weak, the divine light in his eyes had become clear and deep again.

    "Okay, this 'rust' poison has been temporarily suppressed." Wuming Taishang said, "The Pure Spirit Holy Lotus is indeed a rare treasure in the world, and the effect is remarkable. But to completely eradicate it, I am afraid it will take some other opportunities and time."

    Lin Mo was slightly relieved when he heard this, but the stone in his heart was not completely relieved. He knew that Wuming Taishang made it easy, but he knew how poisonous the "rust" was. Even a powerful person like Wuming Taishang is so troublesome, which shows how terrifying it is.

    "Senior, over there at the Meteor God Abyss..." Lin Mo still felt a little uneasy when he thought of the throbbing he felt in the depths of the Meteor God Abyss and the scene when Luo Li cut off alone to protect him.

    The face of the Nameless Supreme Being also became serious: "I have sensed the abnormal movement in the Fallen God Abyss. I am afraid that there is indeed something wrong with the corpse of the fallen god. Moreover, this and the abnormal movements in the forbidden areas we have discovered before are likely to point to the same source - the seal of 'Rust', which is accelerating its collapse."

    He looked at Lin Mo with a deep look: "My child, you have now integrated the "Wushi Sword Sutra" and the Sword Emperor's inheritance to create the unprecedented "Wushi Emperor Sword Embryo", and your strength has greatly improved. But in the face of world-destroying disasters like 'Rust', it is still far from enough. I need you to grow up as soon as possible."

    "Disciple understands." Lin Mo nodded solemnly.
title_en: Chapter 27: Holy Lotus Returns to the Sect, Undercurrents Are Turbulent
